summary: On September 10, 2026, CPI Card Group Inc. entered an underwriting agreement with its sponsors, Tricor Pacific Capital Partners (Fund IV) entities, and B. Riley Securities as representative, covering a secondary block sale of 2,337,323 shares, with a 30-day option for 350,598 more shares exercised in full on September 11, 2026. The offering, under an existing 2021 shelf registration, closed September 14, 2026. The company sold no shares and received no proceeds. CPI Card Group is issuer; Tricor is selling stockholder, a sponsor overhang reduction, not a company-level special situation.
